title: Deterministic transition independence
statement: Let $A$ be a memory-augmented register program, let $D$ be a decider, and choose an initial decider state for each decider index. For any Boolean answer $ eta$ and compiled state $q$ at which the memory-choice map of $A$ is undefined, the transition of the deterministic compilation with answer parameter $ eta$ agrees with the transition using answer parameter false.
hypotheses_covered: The memory-choice map of $A$ is undefined at $q$
